title: Canyons 100K aid-station chart (metric, 2026 revision)
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 2026 100K metric chart places Start at 0.0 km, Deadwood-1 at 18.0, Swinging Bridge at 21.7, Deadwood-2 at 25.4, Michigan Bluff at 36.4, Foresthill at 45.9, Cal 2 at 59.1, Drivers Flat at 74.0, Mammoth Bar at 86.7, Confluence at 92.7 and the finish at 99.1 km.
The chart gives cut-offs of 11:30 at Deadwood-2, 12:45 at Michigan Bluff, 14:30 at Foresthill, 19:45 at Drivers Flat, 22:15 at Mammoth Bar and 01:00 Sunday at the finish.
The chart's cumulative figures are 3,698 m of gain and 4,746 m of loss, versus the race page header's 3,750 m+.
The chart marks drop bags at Foresthill and Drivers Flat and crew access at Deadwood-2, Michigan Bluff and Foresthill; Swinging Bridge is an N/A point with no aid.

The cumulative gain/loss at the named points is 671/-883 at Deadwood-1, 1,248/-1,367 at Swinging Bridge, 1,795/-2,171 at Deadwood-2, 2,153/-2,588 at Michigan Bluff, 2,374/-3,292 at Foresthill, 2,899/-3,819 at Cal 2, 3,199/-4,443 at Drivers Flat, 3,406/-4,662 at Mammoth Bar and 3,698/-4,746 at Confluence.
The chart is marked revision 4/22/26 and says the course is subject to change due to permitting.
